title: Ledge Friends
hook: The smallest Godot game the kit makes: run and jump on a stage and see your friends do it too.

controls.jump: jump (hold Down on a ledge to drop through)

round.winBy: nobody wins: it is a stage to share

rules.summary: Run and jump on the stage with your friends. Nothing to win: the round ends when the clock does.

characters.describe: a small round runner in a cap, seen from the side

accept: the game boots from this spec on runtime godot
two players in one room each see the other where they really are
